title: Bulk remove multiple members from a group
description:
Organization admins can now save time by removing up to 200 members from a group at once in Atlassian Administration. This update to the Group Members table allows admins to manage large groups more efficiently without the need to remove members individually. To remove multiple users in bulk Go to admin.atlassian.com.
	Select your organization if you have more than one.
	Select Directory, then Groups.
